risks.risk: Console may not be fully functional (disc drive issues, overheating, faulty HDMI/power, controller ports). Photos can’t confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the PS4 powering on to the home screen, then launching a game from the disc (or showing installed games) and showing both controllers working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not guaranteed fully working (assume potential faults) until a power-on test is shown.

risks.risk: Game bundle mismatch: seller lists multiple games, but photos only clearly show one FIFA case; other discs may be missing or different versions.
risks.proof: Clear photos of all game discs/cases laid out (front and back), or a video showing the disc tray and the game titles on-screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: only the clearly shown FIFA PS4 case is included.

risks.risk: PS4 Slim variant/storage unknown (CUH model and HDD size affect value).
risks.proof: Photo of the console label (back/bottom) showing CUH model number and serial, plus a screenshot/photo of System Settings > Storage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: generic Slim with unknown/possibly smaller storage.

risks.risk: Controllers condition unknown (stick drift, broken buttons, battery health).
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connected, then a quick test: move sticks in calibration screen (or show controller test) and press all buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: controllers may need repair/are not guaranteed perfect.

proof_requests: Power-on video to home screen + launch one game (disc or installed) showing audio/video working.
Close-up photos of the console label (CUH model) and a photo/screenshot of System Settings > Storage.
Photos of every included game disc/case (front and back) matching the seller’s list.
Video/controller test showing both pads respond correctly (no drift, buttons working).
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS4 Slim-looking console with two controllers and at least one FIFA PS4 case, but they do not prove it is perfectly working or confirm the full game list. Missing operation and bundle verification prevents a confident worst-case price.
